clips.text: I received your letter on my return.
I welcome this birth of determination in you.
Such strength of will alone takes us to truth
Our deepest powers are aroused by it, the unorganized energy becomes organized and then there is music.
What tremendous energy exists in this atom of self!
But it can't be known without utter intensity of will.
You must have seen rocks that even the strongest chisel cannot break, and yet the sprouting shrub or plant slips cracks and crevices through it so easily!
When the tiniest seed is filled with determination to push through and reach the sun, even the hardest rock has to give way.
So a weak seed wins over the mighty rocks!
